name: Burvine
desc: Burvine (Verbena urticifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Verbena urticifolia, known as nettle-leaved vervain or white vervain, is a herbaceous plant in the vervain family (Verbenaceae). It belongs to the "true" vervains of genus Verbena.
